Anya Patel: Heads-up: NVIDIA wants to run a joint power vs latency sweep next week. Goal: perf/W curves across batch sizes, sequence lengths, and kernel variants. Can runtime + eng-ml leads confirm telemetry and kernel access? cc @Samir @Yu
Samir Gomez: We can run kernel sweeps. Need kernel build flags + cuDNN/kernel binary access. What image + driver stack are they giving us? NVLink config? Also, are we testing int8 quantized path or fp16 only?
Yu Cheng: For perf/W we need wall power + per-socket telemetry. Do they expose PMBus/Redfish or will they rely on external power meter? Also propose standard harness: `python perf_runner.py --seq 2048 --bs 1-8 --iters 100` and capture tokens/s + p50/p95/p99 latency.
Anya Patel: They confirmed external power meter + host IPMI for host telemetry. Partner will publish wall W samples; we capture tokens/sec and tail latency on our side. They want kernel toggles for fused attention and prefetch enabled. Samir, can you add a kernel-tag to logs so we can map results to build flags?
Samir Gomez: Yup. I'll add a `--kernel-tag` flag and ensure build metadata is embedded in logs. Draft run command I'm planning to use:
```
./run_infer.sh --model redwood-2-xl --bs 4 --seq 1024 --quant none --kernel 'fused+prefetch' --tag nv-gpu-sweep
```
I'll push a CI job under ci/perf-sweeps tomorrow. Also need confirmation on whether to isolate NVLink for multi-card runs.
ops-bot: CI job created: ci/perf-sweeps/bench-nvidia-1763701234
Yu Cheng: A few measurement notes: normalize to tokens/s/W, include latency SLO lines on plots, warmup 20 iters, and capture KV-cache warm vs cold behavior separately. Capture host CPU power and GPU board-level power if partner can provide it.
Anya Patel: Plan: baseline (stock kernels), fused, fused+prefetch; run both fp16 and int8 where supported. Timeline: partner installs hardware Wed, internal runs Thu-Fri. Samir/Yu share scripts + dataset by Tue EOD. I'll coordinate press/partner comms with partnerships/legal after first validated run.
Samir Gomez: On it. I'll add scripts to `tools/perf/nvidia_sweep` and post the link when done. Will include a README with exact kernel flags.
Anya Patel: :thumbsup: Thanks team. @Yu can you prepare a short regression checklist (latency regressions, reproducibility, perf/W plotting script)? We'll loop in the partner PM once we have first-run artifacts and a short slide deck for partner review.
